sloka: ततस्तु रक्षः क्षतजानुलिप्तं वित्रासनं देवमहाचमूनाम्।विव्याध तं मुद्गरमुग्रवेगं विद्रावयामास चमूं हरीणाम् ।। ६.६७.१४३ ।।
transliteration: tatastu rakṣaḥ kṣatajānuliptaṁ vitrāsanaṁ devamahācamūnām।vivyādha taṁ mudgaramugravegaṁ vidrāvayāmāsa camūṁ harīṇām ।। 6.67.143 ।।

translations.english: With blood red eyes, licking the corner of his mouth with his tongue, crushing Vanara army, he looked like God of Death at dissolution.
